sentiment.rationale: The document shows a clear positive inflection in automotive margins (excluding credits improved from 15.4% to 17.9% sequentially) and total gross margin reached 20.1%, the best in over two years, despite lower deliveries. Forward guidance is not formally raised in dollar terms, but management expresses strong confidence in the autonomous future, with CyberCab production starting in April and robotaxi fleet doubling monthly. However, the score is tempered by explicit risks: energy margin compression from competition and tariffs, short-term automotive margin pressure from the FSD subscription shift, and a massive $20B+ capex plan that will burn cash.

summary.revenue: Energy revenue reached nearly $12.8 billion for the year, increasing 26.6% year over year. Automotive revenue not explicitly stated as a single figure, but deliveries were 16% lower sequentially.
summary.guidance: CapEx for 2026 forecasted to exceed $20 billion, with spending targeted at six factories, AI compute infrastructure, and fleet expansion. CyberCab production expected to start in April. Model S and X production winding down next quarter. Energy margin compression expected from competition, policy uncertainty, and tariffs. Short-term automotive margin pressure from FSD subscription shift.
summary.margin: Automotive gross margin excluding credits improved sequentially from 15.4% to 17.9%. Total gross margin exceeded 20.1%, the highest in over two years. Services and other margin declined from 10.5% to 8.8%.
key_risks: Energy margin compression from increased low-cost competition, policy uncertainty, and tariffs.
Short-term automotive margin pressure from the transition to a subscription-based FSD sales model.
Net income negatively impacted by a 23% depreciation of Bitcoin holdings and unfavorable foreign exchange from intercompany borrowings.
Long-term chip supply constraint without domestic fab investment (TerraFab).
Battery supply constraint described as the biggest global constraint.
key_opportunities: Record deliveries in smaller markets and a bigger year-end backlog than recent years.
Robotaxi fleet exceeding 500 vehicles and doubling monthly, with paid unsupervised rides in Austin.
CyberCab production start in April, expected to become the highest-volume model long-term.
Energy revenue growing 26.6% with record gross profit and strong global demand.
Optimus robot factory planned with a million-unit annual capacity goal.
FSD paid customers reached nearly 1.1 million globally.

management_tone.label: optimistic
management_tone.justification: Elon Musk updated the mission to 'amazing abundance' and stated 'the future is more exciting than you can imagine,' while Vaibhav Taneja described 2026 as 'the most exciting change in Tesla, Inc.'s history.'
